caption: Hypothetical exercise — figures, quotes and events are invented assumptions, not current market news.
scope: Current authored30 homepage variants under controlled dates; no claim of real events or review of daily-page answers

variants.scenario: OPEC+ surprise production cut of 1M bpd.
variants.context: Crude jumps 4% on the announcement. Inventories have been building for 6 weeks.

variants.scenario: Binance announces a major token burn.
variants.context: 12% of supply removed. Volume already 3x average.

variants.scenario: China announces 200% tariff on US chips.
variants.context: NVDA -8% premarket. China is ~12% of NVDA revenue. Datacenter demand globally remains insatiable.

variants.scenario: BTC funding rates spike to +0.15% (4-hour).
variants.context: Price flat. Open interest at record highs. Spot volume below average.

variants.scenario: Tesla unveils a sub-$25K model.
variants.context: Stock spikes 9% on the news. Margins guidance unclear. Production starts in 18 months.

variants.scenario: SPY tests the 200-day MA after a 10% correction.
variants.context: VIX at 28 (elevated). Breadth: only 35% of stocks above their 50-day. Put/call ratio at 1.4.

variants.scenario: Ethereum staking yield drops below 2.5%.
variants.context: Validator queue is full. Restaking protocols (EigenLayer) absorbing capital. ETH spot ETF flows turned negative.

variants.scenario: BoJ intervenes verbally. USD/JPY at 158.
variants.context: Last actual intervention was at 152. MoF officials called move 'one-sided.' Carry trade flows still strong.

variants.scenario: NVDA splits 10-for-1.
variants.context: Retail interest surges. Options activity hits records. Stock up 4% on the announcement.

variants.scenario: BTC halving happens this week.
variants.context: In this invented scenario, price is already up 80% year to date. Compare possible price rises and falls after the event; the halving does not establish either outcome.

variants.scenario: Apple beats earnings but guides Q1 lower.
variants.context: Stock down 4% after-hours. Services revenue grew 18%. iPhone guidance cut on China softness.

variants.scenario: 10-year yield crosses above 5%.
variants.context: QQQ down 2% intraday. Tech leadership weakening. Equal-weight QQQ outperforming.

variants.scenario: Robotaxi event delivers underwhelming demo.
variants.context: Stock down 9% the next session. Demo lacked details on regulatory path. But FSD subscription revenue grew 60% QoQ in background.

variants.scenario: Gold breaks $2,800 to new all-time highs.
variants.context: Central bank buying + retail FOMO + miner shares lagging.

variants.scenario: Meta reports record ad revenue. Stock unchanged.
variants.context: Beat top + bottom line by 8%. CEO commentary muted. Sector peers underperforming.

variants.scenario: Solana memecoin volume crashes 70% in a week.
variants.context: Network revenue down 50%. Validators struggling. Real-app usage still growing.

variants.scenario: First red Monday after 8 green weeks.
variants.context: SPY -1.2%. Breadth -3:1 negative. No specific catalyst. Bond yields stable.

variants.scenario: NVDA reports earnings tonight. Implied move is ±8%.
variants.context: Street expects $0.85 EPS on $36B revenue. Whisper number is $0.92. AI capex guidance from hyperscalers came in strong this week.

variants.scenario: BTC breaks $100K resistance on heavy volume.
variants.context: Funding rates are still neutral, open interest just hit ATH, and spot ETF inflows posted $1.2B yesterday.

variants.scenario: Tesla drops 12% on a weak delivery number.
variants.context: Q3 deliveries missed by 4%. Stock gapped down at the open and is now consolidating at the day's low.

variants.scenario: ETH/BTC ratio breaks a 6-month downtrend.
variants.context: ETH has been underperforming BTC for half a year. Today the ratio crossed back above its 50-day MA.

variants.scenario: Apple announces a $90B buyback expansion.
variants.context: Stock is up 2% premarket. RSI on the daily is already 71. iPhone unit growth has been flat for 4 quarters.

variants.scenario: Fed pauses rate cuts. SPY drops 1.5% intraday.
variants.context: Powell signaled 'higher for longer.' VIX spiked to 22. Volume is 1.4x the 20-day average.

variants.scenario: Solana network outage for 4 hours.
variants.context: Validator software bug. Price down 7%. Devs say a patch is rolling out within 24h.

variants.scenario: DXY dollar index breaks below a 2-year support.
variants.context: Real yields are falling. Central banks added a record amount of gold to reserves last quarter.

variants.scenario: Meta announces $50B+ AI capex for next year.
variants.context: Stock down 6% on the news. Wall Street worries about ROI. But internal metrics show Reels engagement up 40% YoY thanks to AI ranking.

variants.scenario: ECB hawkish surprise: Lagarde signals one more hike.
variants.context: EUR/USD spikes 80 pips in 5 minutes. Pre-news positioning was net short EUR.

variants.scenario: Microsoft adds OpenAI o4 to all Copilot tiers.
variants.context: Stock flat on the news. Enterprise Copilot adoption was already accelerating (40% QoQ).

variants.scenario: DOJ proposes forcing Google to sell Chrome.
variants.context: Stock down 5% premarket. Legal experts give it 30% odds of happening. Process would take 3+ years.

variants.scenario: QQQ goes 5 days straight up. RSI hits 78.
variants.context: AI-driven rally. No pullback in 2 weeks.
